design: A human medieval highway bandit, matching the player characters' stylized three-head-tall proportions, scruffy dark-brown hair, short stubbly beard, sharp dark eyes, arched cynical brows and a smug crooked grin. Worn ochre/brown short coat over burgundy tunic, patched leather shoulder guard and gloves, leather belt and trousers, scuffed boots. A red scarf at neck and short curved iron saber in foreground hand. Looks like a sneaky comic villain, not innocent or baby-like. Exactly two arms and legs and the SAME saber throughout. Idle standing with saber down, subtle breathing and blink with feet locked; hurt angry recoil; attack winds up and slashes toward RIGHT, recovery; dodge ducks and shifts back without duplicates or streaks. Sword fully inside every cell.
